recipe.variant: pixel-space hires fix: ESRGAN 4x -> ImageScale down to the target -> VAEEncode -> second KSampler at denoise 0.5 (uni_pc_bh2 / normal / 14 steps / cfg 8) -> VAEDecode; a stage that takes an upstream image plus the checkpoint and prompts that made it
recipe.from_template: hiresfix_esrgan_workflow (archived; ComfyUI_examples 'non-latent upscaling'): the second pass is the template's node for node and value for value (RealESRGAN_x4plus -> ImageScale bilinear 1024x1024 -> VAEEncode -> KSampler 14 steps uni_pc_bh2/normal cfg 8 denoise 0.5 -> VAEDecode -> SaveImage); the template's own first pass (DreamShaper 8, 512x512, 12 steps dpmpp_sde) is replaced by the @image slot so the stage refines whatever the previous stage produced. The template's ImageScale targets 1024x1024 on a square source; here height=0 keeps the aspect from width.

fragment.scale_math: ESRGAN gives 4x; ImageScale brings it to the pass-2 size (template: 512 -> 2048 -> 1024 = 2x overall). 'Since ESRGAN operates in pixel space the image must be converted to pixel space and back to latent space after being upscaled.'

prompt.note: standalone context: the official examples reuse pass 1's prompt; the 'different prompt' example swaps checkpoint and prompt for pass 2

checkpoint.note: the checkpoint that produced the input image (the template's DreamShaper_8_pruned.safetensors is a placeholder)

target_width.note: the pass-2 width in pixels; 0 = derive from height

target_height.note: 0 = keep aspect from width (template: 1024x1024 on a 512 square)

denoise.note: 0.5 (both official hires-fix examples; 0.52 pose example; 0.35 in the different-prompt example); the ESRGAN output is already sharp so lower values are plausible but no official number exists (NOT FOUND)

image.note: the image to refine at a higher resolution, typically the previous stage's decoded output; output = target_width x (aspect-derived height)

recipe.defaults_note: 4x ESRGAN then resize to 1024 wide (2x of the template's 512 source), VAEEncode with the checkpoint's VAE, 14 steps uni_pc_bh2/normal cfg 8 denoise 0.5. The checkpoint and prompts must be the upstream stage's (SD1.5 placeholder here).
